name: pushery/legal-consent-for-laravel
description: Court-proof, versioned legal consent for Laravel — GDPR-correct separation of contract acceptance, notice acknowledgement, and consent, with an append-only audit trail.

suggest.laravel/fortify: Record registration consent inside the account-creating request (Way A).
suggest.livewire/livewire: Opt-in reactive UI: the ReConsentForm and ConsentSettings inline components (publish the plain or WireKit-flavored views).
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Assertions for Consent::fake(): the in-memory double calls PHPUnit\Framework\Assert, so every assert*() method needs PHPUnit on the class path. Any Pest or PHPUnit test toolchain already brings it.
suggest.pushery/wirekit: WireKit-native view variant, 2.26.0 or newer: publish --tag=legal-consent-wirekit, or leave ui.variant on its 'auto' default and the themed views are served as soon as the package is installed.
